ev-remove.unreachable.say: Evalation could not be reached, so nothing was changed. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-remove again.

ev-remove.clock.say: This machine's clock is wrong, so Evalation cannot sign it out and nothing was removed. Set the clock to the right time, then run /ev-remove again.

ev-remove.damaged.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged, so Evalation cannot sign it out from here.

ev-remove.not-signed-in.say: This machine is not signed in to Evalation, so there is nothing to sign out.

ev-remove.sign-out.say: This signs this machine out of Evalation and deletes its keys from this machine's password store. Other machines and your account are unaffected, so your pack credits stay and you can sign in again on any machine.

ev-remove.folder.say: It also deletes Evalation's own folder on this machine, with the saved results of each check, your pack choice and any question sets saved only here. Question sets kept on your account stay.

ev-remove.folder-local.say: Removing deletes Evalation's own folder on this machine, with the saved results of each check, your pack choice and any question sets saved here.

ev-remove.sets-stay-local.say: Evalation cannot reach your account from this machine, so the question sets saved here cannot be kept on it.

ev-remove.nothing-saved.say: Evalation has saved nothing on this machine, so there is nothing to delete.

ev-remove.only-sign-in.say: Evalation holds only this machine's damaged sign-in and its keys here. Removing deletes them.

ev-remove.nothing-else.say: Evalation has nothing else on this machine.

ev-remove.old-reports.say: Evalation's own folder also holds reports an older version of Evalation saved there: <reports>. Removing deletes them with it. Reports in your Documents folder stay.

ev-remove.report.say: the <names> from the check of <repository> on <date>

options.label: Remove it
options.description: Signs this machine out and deletes Evalation's folder and keys here.

options.label: Remove it
options.description: Deletes what Evalation saved on this machine.

ev-remove.keep-sets.ask: Keep <sets> on your account before removing?

options.label: Keep on my account
options.description: Copies them to your account so any machine you sign in on can use them.

ev-remove.keep-set.ask: Keep <sets> on your account before removing?

options.label: Keep on my account
options.description: Copies it to your account so any machine you sign in on can use it.

ev-remove.conversations.say: Claude Code keeps <count> other conversations in which you ran an Evalation command, including what Evalation found in your code. They come from these project folders: <places>. Deleting them removes only those conversations and cannot be undone. This conversation and every one without an Evalation command stay, and nothing in your project folders is touched.

ev-remove.conversation.say: Claude Code keeps one other conversation in which you ran an Evalation command, including what Evalation found in your code. It comes from the project folder <folder>, on <from>. Deleting it removes only that conversation and cannot be undone. This conversation and every one without an Evalation command stay, and nothing in your project folders is touched.

ev-remove.open-one.say: One of them is open in another Claude Code window, so it is kept. To delete it too, close that window before you answer.

ev-remove.open-many.say: <count> of them are open in other Claude Code windows, so they are kept. To delete those too, close those windows before you answer.

ev-remove.recent-one.say: One of them changed in the last hour, so it is kept in case it is still open in another window.

ev-remove.recent-many.say: <count> of them changed in the last hour, so they are kept in case one is still open in another window.

ev-remove.clear.ask: Also delete the Claude Code conversations that used Evalation?

options.label: Delete them
options.description: Deletes those conversations, except any still open.

options.label: Keep them
options.description: Leaves every conversation in Claude Code.

ev-remove.set-fails.ask: The question set "<set>" cannot be kept on your account until it is fixed with /ev-questions. What should happen to it?

options.label: Delete it with the rest
options.description: Deletes the set with Evalation's folder and goes on removing.

options.label: Stop so I can fix it
options.description: Removes nothing, so you can fix the set first.

ev-remove.fix-set.say: Nothing was removed. Run /ev-remove again once the set is fixed.

ev-remove.set-not-kept.say: The question set "<set>" could not be kept on your account, so nothing was removed. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-remove again.

ev-remove.run-unreachable.say: Evalation could not be reached, so nothing was removed. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-remove again.

ev-remove.run-refused.say: Evalation would not sign this machine out, so nothing was removed. Contact support@evalation.ai for help.

ev-remove.signed-out.say: This machine is signed out of Evalation.

ev-remove.already-out.say: This machine was already signed out of Evalation, so nothing was signed out.

ev-remove.not-revoked.say: Evalation could not sign this machine out, so email support@evalation.ai to have its sign-in switched off.

ev-remove.sets-kept.say: The question sets <sets> are kept on your account.

ev-remove.folder-deleted.say: Evalation's folder on this machine is deleted.

ev-remove.folder-left.say: Some of Evalation's files on this machine could not be deleted. Run /ev-remove again to finish.

ev-remove.key-left.say: One key is still in this machine's password store: <keys>. Delete it there by hand, such as in Keychain Access on a Mac.

ev-remove.keys-left.say: <count> keys are still in this machine's password store: <keys>. Delete them there by hand, such as in Keychain Access on a Mac.

ev-remove.keys-unread.say: Evalation could not read which keys it kept on this machine, so they may still be in its password store. Delete them there by hand, such as in Keychain Access on a Mac. Each has the service evalation-plugin, or evalation on an older setup, and an account ending in installation-key, receiving-key or receiving-key-previous. Where this machine also runs the Evalation engine, leave the entries the engine uses.

ev-remove.kept-this.say: This conversation is still open, so it was kept. Close it and it stays in Claude Code's history like any other.

ev-remove.kept-two.say: This conversation and one other still open in Claude Code were kept. Both stay in Claude Code's history like any other.

ev-remove.kept-more.say: This conversation and <count> others still open in Claude Code were kept. Each stays in Claude Code's history like any other.

ev-remove.recent-this.say: This conversation was kept, since Evalation cannot tell whether it is still open. Close it and it stays in Claude Code's history like any other.

ev-remove.recent-more.say: <count> conversations that changed in the last hour were kept, this one among them, since Evalation cannot tell which are still open. Each stays in Claude Code's history like any other.

ev-remove.history-failed.say: The conversations could not be deleted.

ev-remove.uninstall.say: The plugin cannot uninstall itself. To finish, run this in Claude Code:

ev-remove.other.say: That answer is not one of the choices, so Evalation removed nothing.
